i keep thinking about all these specific memories — like we used to do this dumb thing where we'd all pile into jamie's car and just drive nowhere — and it's like those memories are of a different person. someone who existed in that context and now that context is gone.

i don't know. sometimes i think that version of me is just dead. and i don't know if this version is worth keeping.
